messages:
Priya Nair: Heads up 100 Meridian ops emailed: they want to cut the renewal to 9 months, split payment monthly, and have procurement attach their vendor code to invoices. Also asking to see the SSO appendix in DocuSign before signing. Redline: https://docsend.example/meridian-reup
Gabe Torres: Thanks. What's their current ARR and what would monthly look like if we do 9mo with a 5% concession?
Priya Nair: ARR = $120k. 9mo pro-rata = $90k. With 5% term concession total = $85,500 -> monthly = $9,500 (rounded).
Elena V.: Finance: monthly invoicing ok; Net30 requires PO with vendor code and confirmed billing entity. Without valid PO it's CC/wire only. Also need to know whether they want invoice split or recurring invoice setup in our billing system.
Samir D.: Legal: SSO appendix (Okta) is fine as an exhibit. We can publish envelope with appendix visible. Will add minimal attestation and data contact fields.
Gabe Torres: Do we need sales approval for 5%? @Elena V. please confirm margin impact.
Elena V.: 5% is within delegated authority for CSMs on mid-market accounts. Finance ok as long as it's one-time and signed this quarter. Approve.
Priya Nair: Sending them PO template now and will ask for vendor code string.
Priya Nair: PO template we provided:
``
PO Number: ________
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Vendor Code: ________
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Frequency: Monthly
Payment Terms: Net30 (with PO)
Total Amount: $85,500
Contact: billing@meridian.example
``
Gabe Torres: I'll message the CFO: "We can do 9mo with 5% concession; monthly invoices available. Net30 accepted once PO with vendor code is attached. We'll send a DocuSign envelope including the Okta SSO appendix for review before signature."
SignFlowBot: Reminder set: follow up in 48h if PO/PDF not received.
Priya Nair: Customer replied: "Procurement will send PO tonight. Vendor code MER-X9 provided. Please include SSO appendix in the envelope." :thumbsup:
Samir D.: I'll finalize redline and confirm DocuSign envelope setup. We'll include a checkbox that attests to SSO contact details.
Elena V.: Once signed + PO attached, billing will schedule monthly invoices starting next billing period. CC billing@redwood.example on the envelope.
Priya Nair: Great. Marking thread as in-flight. Will update when DocuSign sent and first invoice queued.
SignFlowBot: Thread status -> in_progress. Next reminder in 48h.
